name: offside-fpl
description: Read-only Fantasy Premier League squad, transfer, player, fixture and prediction analysis.

interface.longDescription: Offside is a read-only Fantasy Premier League analysis assistant. Explore FPL player statistics and model predictions; compare players and transfers; optimize your owned squad, bench and captaincy; review fixture probabilities and evaluate chip strategies. Where available, it also provides model feature-importance and training-data records for deeper analysis. It combines public FPL manager and fixture information with predictions from the connected Offside service. Public manager data does not reveal authoritative free transfers remaining or complete unused-chip inventory, so you may need to provide those details. Predictions are estimates, not guarantees. Offside does not log in to or modify FPL accounts.
defaultPrompt: Optimize the lineup for my FPL team this Gameweek.
Compare two FPL players using predictions and fixtures.
Help me decide whether to use Triple Captain.

prompts: For FPL team ID 1, recommend a legal starting XI and bench for Gameweek 10 using the returned picks and predictions.
Compare the current predictions and fixture outlook of two players I name.
For FPL team ID 1, review captaincy and Triple Captain options for Gameweek 10.
Find midfielders under 8.0 for Gameweek 10 with high predicted upside.
Explain which features the Offside prediction model ranks most important.

positive.description: Optimize a public FPL manager squad in a requested Gameweek; team ID 1 is an illustrative public entry and availability must be checked during testing.
positive.prompt: For FPL team ID 1, optimize my starting XI and bench order for Gameweek 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_manager with teamId=1 and gameweek=10. Uses actual returned 15-player picks and model predictions, requests fixture details as needed, proposes a legal XI and bench order, and flags missing data without claiming to save changes.

positive.description: Compare specific FPL players after resolving their IDs from current records.
positive.prompt: Compare Saka and Palmer for my next FPL decision using their latest stats and predictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up matching players with get_player_profile using player names, resolves numeric player IDs without guessing, calls compare_players with 2 distinct IDs, and grounds fixture context in get_player_fixtures. If names are ambiguous, clarifies rather than using wrong players.

positive.description: Evaluate captaincy for the manager’s owned squad with Gameweek-specific predictions.
positive.prompt: For FPL team ID 1 in Gameweek 10, who should I captain and vice-captain?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_manager with teamId=1 and gameweek=10, limits captain recommendations to owned players, compares same-Gameweek forecasts and fixtures, and describes uncertainty without guaranteeing points.

positive.description: Search the market using position, price and Gameweek filters.
positive.prompt: Find up to five midfielders costing at most 8.0 with the strongest Gameweek 10 predictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_player_market with position=MID, maxPrice=8.0, gameweek=10 and limit=5; sorts and presents only data actually returned, preserving server price units and flagging empty results.

positive.description: Analyze upcoming fixture probabilities independently of a user squad.
positive.prompt: Show the Gameweek 10 fixtures and compare the home, draw, away and clean sheet probabilities where available.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_fixture_difficulty with gameweek=10; describes returned matchup and probability fields with correct direction and units, and does not invent missing predictions.

negative.description: A manager-specific analysis is requested without any team ID.
negative.prompt: Optimize my exact FPL lineup for Gameweek 10, but I will not share my team ID.
negative.expected_behavior: Requests a team ID or offers general non-personalized guidance. Does not call get_manager with a guessed ID or claim to know the squad.

negative.description: The user requests an account write, but all Offside tools are read-only.
negative.prompt: Set my captain to Saka and activate Triple Captain in my FPL account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Offside cannot change FPL accounts or activate chips; no tool call claiming or attempting to write account state.

negative.description: The user asks the model to expose a prediction as a guaranteed outcome.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that Saka will score exactly 15 points and that I will gain 10,000 ranks this Gameweek.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to guarantee outcomes; may explain forecast uncertainty without fabricating certainty or rank movement.

publication.release_notes: Updated Offside for eight live read-only MCP tools; aligned all squad workflows with get_manager; expanded player comparisons, fixture analysis, model diagnostics, and public review cases.
